Cantu Shea Butter for Natural Hair Coconut Curling Cream is a styling cream designed for natural curls, coils and waves. Its formula combines shea butter with coconut oil and other conditioning ingredients to moisturise hair while helping define curl patterns.

products.name: Kristal Fragrance Mist (Brume Parfumée)
products.nameRw: Spray ya Kristo ya Brume Parfumée
products.description:
Kristal Fragrance Mist is a fine, lightweight body spray with a delicate floral scent that refreshes and uplifts. It is formulated with gentle, plant-based ingredients to lightly perfume skin without weighing it down. When sprayed on skin or clothing, it envelops you in a pleasant aroma that feels clean and invigorating. 

This easy-to-use mist is perfect for daily use, especially after showering or bathing. It can be reapplied anytime throughout the day to maintain a subtle, long-lasting fragrance aura. The non-greasy formula dries quickly, leaving skin soft and lightly scented without any sticky residue.
products.descriptionRw:
Spray ya **Kristal Fragrance Mist (Brume Parfumée)** ni umuti woroshye wo kwisiga ku mubiri, ukungahaye ku mpumuro y'ibimera yoroheje itera umwuka wo kumererwa neza. Yakozwe mu buryo bworoheje, ikoresha ibikomoka ku bimera idasize amavuta ku ruhu. Iyo usize iyi spray ku mubiri cyangwa ku myenda, igufunga mu mwuka w'impumuro nziza, biguha kumva ko umerewe neza kandi ubyutse. 

Uyu musego woroshye ukoreshwa buri munsi cyane cyane nyuma yo koga. Wakwakira kanda uyisige umubiri wawe cyangwa imyenda, ugahora ufite impumuro igezweho. Formule yayo idacogoza ituma ikwihutira gushira, uruhu rukabaho rworoshye kandi rusagamba impumuro nziza nta nkweto yasiga.
products.shortDescription: Lightweight body mist with a fresh floral fragrance for all-day freshness.
products.shortDescriptionRw: Spray yoroshye yo kwisiga umubiri ifite impumuro y'ibimera, ituma uruhu rutanga uburyohe umunsi wose.

Alukolo ifasha gukwirakwiza impumuro ku ruhu, impumuro y'ibimera itanga uburyohe ku mubiri, naho gaze zoroshye zifasha kuyikwirakwiza neza.

products.description:
LA Tchadienne Whitening Lotion is a potent brightening formula designed for both facial and body skin. It is enriched with active ingredients like Vitamin C, Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) and Kojic Acid to deeply hydrate skin while gradually reducing dark spots and uneven pigmentation. The lightweight, non-greasy lotion absorbs quickly, leaving skin feeling smooth and looking more uniform in tone. 

Regular use helps to reveal a more even, luminous complexion. After application, skin feels refreshed and well-moisturized. Over weeks of consistent use, persistent blemishes and hyperpigmented areas become noticeably lighter and the skin's natural radiance and softness are restored.

Gukoresha buri munsi bituma uruhu rwiyongera kumurika no kugaragara neza. Nyuma yo gusiga, uruhu rwumva rworoshye kandi rwuzuye amazi. Mu gihe cy'amezi make wakoresheje, ibimenyetso n'amabara akomeza kugabanuka, uruhu rugaruka rwerekana itoto ry'umwimerere n'ubworoherane.
